caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, reddish-brown terra cotta flower pot placed centrally against a neutral background. The pot has a wide, slightly flared rim, a bulbous body that narrows at the base, and rests on a rounded foot, which sits on a flat wooden surface with visible grain lines. The flower pot has subtle, darker brown markings and shading to suggest texture and curvature, and it appears empty. Above the pot, the capitalized text "FLOWER POT" is written in grayish-blue letters. The composition is simple, with the pot occupying most of the image and the wood surface extending horizontally at the bottom.
title: Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
